rules.scope: This route inspection frames only; acquisition, transit and return excluded from ranking but shown separately by fixed selection.
rules.tie_break: Ascending original frame index, as specified in each rule.
rules.empty_target_note: Keep inspection frames with zero target truth; show truth_in_scope and framing context, never label absence as detector failure.
rules.same_frame_multiple_roles: Keep role labels; deduplicate only the displayed image asset.
